import pandas as pd


def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    events = inputs["events"].copy()

    # Ensure proper types for sorting / time arithmetic
    events["event_ts"] = pd.to_datetime(events["event_ts"])

    # Stable sort: user_id, channel, event_ts, event_id
    events = events.sort_values(
        by=["user_id", "channel", "event_ts", "event_id"],
        kind="mergesort"
    ).reset_index(drop=True)

    group_cols = ["user_id", "channel"]

    # Previous timestamp within the same (user_id, channel) stream
    prev_ts = events.groupby(group_cols)["event_ts"].shift(1)
    gap = events["event_ts"] - prev_ts

    # New session starts when there is no previous event (first in group)
    # or the gap strictly exceeds 25 minutes.
    new_session = prev_ts.isna() | (gap > pd.Timedelta(minutes=25))

    # 1-based session number per (user_id, channel)
    events["session_num"] = new_session.groupby(
        [events["user_id"], events["channel"]]
    ).cumsum()

    result = (
        events.groupby(group_cols + ["session_num"], as_index=False)
        .agg(
            session_start=("event_ts", "min"),
            session_end=("event_ts", "max"),
            event_count=("event_id", "count"),
        )
    )

    result = result.sort_values(
        by=["user_id", "channel", "session_num"], kind="mergesort"
    ).reset_index(drop=True)

    result = result[
        ["user_id", "channel", "session_num", "session_start", "session_end", "event_count"]
    ]

    return {"channel_sessions": result}
